lines.voiceText: The crowd paid for BLOOD, not a stakeout, challenger!

lines.text: Our challenger appears to have taken ROOT, folks! Management is preparing... motivation!
lines.subtitle: Our challenger appears to have taken ROOT, folks! Management is preparing... motivation!
lines.voiceText: Our challenger appears to have taken ROOT, folks! Management is preparing... motivation!

lines.text: BO-RING! Somebody light a fire under this one. That can be arranged, actually!
lines.subtitle: BO-RING! Somebody light a fire under this one. That can be arranged, actually!
lines.voiceText: BO-RING! Somebody light a fire under this one. That can be arranged, actually!

lines.text: Folks, I've seen furniture with more footwork. MOVE!
lines.subtitle: Folks, I've seen furniture with more footwork. MOVE!
lines.voiceText: Folks, I've seen furniture with more footwork. MOVE!

lines.text: Is the challenger NAPPING? Wake-up call is being arranged!
lines.subtitle: Is the challenger NAPPING? Wake-up call is being arranged!
lines.voiceText: Is the challenger NAPPING? Wake-up call is being arranged!

lines.text: This isn't hide and seek, kid! The crowd found you HOURS ago!
lines.subtitle: This isn't hide and seek, kid! The crowd found you HOURS ago!
lines.voiceText: This isn't hide and seek, kid! The crowd found you HOURS ago!

lines.text: And now... undefeated in THIRTY-ONE bouts... the man, the monster... GOLIATH!
lines.subtitle: And now... undefeated in THIRTY-ONE bouts... the man, the monster... GOLIATH!
lines.voiceText: And now... undefeated in THIRTY-ONE bouts... the man, the monster... GOLIATH!

lines.text: Hide the children, cancel the ambulance — it's too late for all that. GOLIATH IS HERE!
lines.subtitle: Hide the children, cancel the ambulance — it's too late for all that. GOLIATH IS HERE!
lines.voiceText: Hide the children, cancel the ambulance — it's too late for all that. GOLIATH IS HERE!

lines.text: Thirty-one bouts. Thirty-one caskets. Ladies and gentlemen... GOLIATH!
lines.subtitle: Thirty-one bouts. Thirty-one caskets. Ladies and gentlemen... GOLIATH!
lines.voiceText: Thirty-one bouts. Thirty-one caskets. Ladies and gentlemen... GOLIATH!

lines.text: I don't believe it. I DO NOT believe it. GOLIATH IS DOWN! WE HAVE A NEW CHAMPION!
lines.subtitle: I don't believe it. I DO NOT believe it. GOLIATH IS DOWN! WE HAVE A NEW CHAMPION!
lines.voiceText: I don't believe it. I DO NOT believe it. GOLIATH IS DOWN! WE HAVE A NEW CHAMPION!

lines.text: STOP THE PRESSES! GOLIATH HAS FALLEN! Bow to your NEW CHAMPION!
lines.subtitle: STOP THE PRESSES! GOLIATH HAS FALLEN! Bow to your NEW CHAMPION!
lines.voiceText: STOP THE PRESSES! GOLIATH HAS FALLEN! Bow to your NEW CHAMPION!
